name: Erythrocyte differentiation with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members cover primitive and definitive erythropoiesis, heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport; the heme synthesis and oxygen-carrying members are what the erythroid confusables lack.

qualifier: dependence receptors in absence of ligand, anoikis, developmental
name: Dependence receptor apoptosis, anoikis and developmental cell death
rationale: Members concern ligand-withdrawal dependence-receptor apoptosis, anoikis regulation and developmental/involution death, unlike the p75NTR/neuronal-death and apoptotic-execution confusables.

qualifier: VEGF/FGF control, activation, apoptosis and vascular repair
name: Endothelial VEGF/FGF control of angiogenesis and vascular repair
rationale: All members regulate endothelial proliferation, survival, migration or activation via VEGF/FGF in sprouting and wound healing, mixing positive and negative control unlike the one-directional angiogenesis confusables.

name: Bacterial ligand sensing via TLR2/4/5 and NOD1/2
rationale: Members detect LPS, lipopeptides, peptidoglycan and flagellin via TLR2/4/5 (incl. MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency) and NOD1/2, which distinguishes it from TRIF, inflammasome-cytokine and TLR-regulation confusables.

qualifier: neural plate border and axial mesoderm
name: Neural plate, border and axial mesoderm specification
rationale: Members specify the anterior/posterior neural plate, its border and crest, floor plate, notochord and dorsoventral axis, unlike hindbrain, spinal cord or convergent-extension confusables.

qualifier: photoreceptors, retinal neurons, lens and anterior segment
name: Eye morphogenesis and photoreceptor, retinal neuron and lens development
rationale: Members build retinal neurons, photoreceptor outer segments, lens, cornea, iris and eyelid, distinct from the phototransduction/retinoid and retinal-vasculature confusables.

name: Dendritic, T and plasma cell surface signatures
rationale: Most members are leukocyte surface-marker signatures centred on dendritic cells plus T, plasma cell and butyrophilin sets, which the monocyte- and MHC-presentation confusables lack.

core: Transcriptional control of redox and central carbon metabolism
name: NRF2 and p53 control of redox and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target programmes and its regulation plus p53/mTORC1 control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate shunt and NADP+, unlike the FOXO and HIF/hypoxia confusables.

name: Transsulfuration, cysteine catabolism and sulfide oxidation
rationale: Members cover homocysteine-to-cysteine transsulfuration, cysteine and hydrogen sulfide catabolism and the molybdenum cofactor of sulfite oxidation, unlike the selenium, vitamin B6 and glutathione confusables.

name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription with DREAM/RB-family repression
rationale: All members are E2F target networks and G1/S cell cycle transcription; the DREAM and p107/p130 repression members distinguish it from the mitotic and replication-origin confusables.

core: Systemic glucose and lipid energy homeostasis
name: Insulin secretion, insulin action and adipocyte energy homeostasis
rationale: Members span beta-cell insulin secretion and incretins, insulin signalling and glucose uptake, adipogenesis, thermogenesis and triglyceride storage, which the phospholipid, glycerol and glycogen confusables lack.

qualifier: proximal IRS/SHC-SOS to AKT2 and glycogen synthesis
name: Proximal insulin/IGF1 receptor signalling via IRS, SHC and AKT2
rationale: Members are IRS/SHC-SOS adaptor events, AKT2 activation, signal attenuation and insulin-regulated glycogen and glucose import, unlike the GLUT4/adiponectin and generic PI3K-AKT confusables.

qualifier: colony-stimulating factor driven granulocyte and monocyte-macrophage
name: CSF-driven granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate granulocyte, monocyte, macrophage and myeloid DC differentiation via G-CSF, M-CSF and GM-CSF, unlike the erythroid/megakaryocyte, RUNX and bone-marrow homeostasis confusables.

qualifier: atypical linkage types and DUB editing
name: Atypical-linkage polyubiquitin chain assembly and editing
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination with K6, K11, K27, K29, branched and free chains plus USP and metalloprotease DUBs, while confusables centre on K48/K63 deubiquitination or proteolysis.

qualifier: E2F G1/S, replication origin licensing and G2/M checkpoints
name: E2F G1/S, replication licensing and G2/M checkpoint control
rationale: Members span E2F/RB G1/S transcription, ORC/CDC6 origin licensing, replication and G2/M DNA damage checkpoints, unlike confusables centred on APC/C, spindle, cohesion and meiosis.

core: Viral genome replication and host restriction
qualifier: retroviral reverse transcription/integration and retroelement silencing
name: Retroviral life cycle and host restriction of viral genomes
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration, APOBEC3G deamination, and host silencing of viral and endogenous retroelement transcription, unlike the ADAR, antibody-diversification and DNA-demethylation confusables.

name: Fructose and glucuronate-xylulose catabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members are fructose catabolism and the glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate pentose route with their inborn errors, unlike the galactose and non-oxidative pentose-phosphate confusables.

core: Membrane potential and monovalent cation transport
name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels and Na+/K+ transport regulation
rationale: Members are K2P and Ca2+-activated K+ channels setting resting potential plus regulation of Na+/K+ transport, unlike the cation-chloride cotransporter, KATP and P-type ATPase confusables.

name: Serotonin, muscarinic and tachykinin receptor control of gut motility
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic and tachykinin receptor signalling with gastric motility, acid secretion and intestinal smooth muscle contraction, unlike the cAMP, histamine/serotonin metabolism and generic smooth muscle confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle contraction, fiber growth and calcineurin-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover sarcomere assembly and contraction, fiber development, growth/atrophy and calcineurin-NFAT and phosphatase regulation, unlike the cardiac adaptation and myoblast confusables.

qualifier: SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer and deconjugation
name: SUMO processing, E1-E2 conjugation and desumoylation
rationale: Members are the core SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins, while confusables are substrate-class SUMOylation sets.

name: Photoreceptor development and outer segment maintenance
rationale: Members concern rod/cone development, outer segment organization, ciliary transition-zone protein targeting and photoreceptor maintenance, unlike ciliary-trafficking and whole-eye morphogenesis confusables.

name: Glial activation and amyloid-beta and tau pathology regulation
rationale: Members regulate microglial and astrocyte activation and amyloid-beta formation/clearance and tangle assembly, whereas confusables centre on amyloid fibril formation and clearance without glial activation.

core: Mitochondrial branched-chain and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism
name: Mitochondrial valine, isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism
rationale: Most members concern valine/isoleucine and short-chain fatty acid catabolism (ECHS1, HIBCH deficiencies) with metabolite repair and biotin, distinguishing it from the leucine-catabolism confusables.

name: p53-driven DNA-damage apoptosis and G1 arrest
rationale: Members are p53 regulation and its transcriptional induction of intrinsic apoptosis and p21-mediated G1 arrest after DNA damage, unlike senescence/p14ARF, phosphorylation and BH3-only confusables.
